Name: Tara O'Dell
Badge: Reading to Write: They Say / I Say
Which version of the They Say / I Say routine (with visual texts or with annotation) feels like the best fit for your students right now? Why?:

I think the visual texts feel like the best fit for me right now, just based on the student population I will be working with, as well as the content I am responsible for covering.

Describe one way you might adapt the They Say / I Say framework to align with the types of texts your students read most often (e.g., articles, visuals, multimodal texts).:

One way I might adapt this to text in my classroom is to, as we are learning about digital citizenship, have them break down the acceptable use policy and handbook and write what they think the text is saying, how they feel about it, and then have a discussion to make sure no one is misunderstanding the expectations.

What, if anything, do you need help thinking through as you plan for using They Say / I Say in your classroom?:

I can't think of anything at the moment, but I will certainly be referring back to this module and the slide presentations moving forward.
